facts.business: Mercury Laboratories Limited manufactures and markets pharmaceutical formulations with a primary focus on gynecology and pediatrics segments in India.
key_risks: Geopolitical tensions and evolving trade policies including tariff measures by major economies
Disruptions in global logistics and supply chains affecting API and packaging material availability and cost
Stringent regulatory requirements and quality standards
Price control mechanisms under DPCO and NPPA
facts.related_party_note: The Company has adopted a Related Party Transaction Policy available on its website at https://mercurylabs.com/mercury-investor-policies.aspx
